values.value: I bought the Ridgeline Rain Jacket (order RO-10482) for $140.00 on October 18, 2026. Ridgeline Outfitters now sells the same item for $110.00. Clause 4.2 of your policy states: "If an item you purchased is sold by Ridgeline Outfitters at a lower price within 14 days of the purchase date, you may request a one-time price adjustment for the difference." I am requesting an adjustment of $30.00.
